column3: “the law” renders “the torah (instruction),” and “most holy” renders “a holy of holies” (also in verse 6).
“to all alike” renders “each like his brother.”
“cakes” renders “hallot,” ring-shaped loaves, and “well stirred” renders “mixed (murbeket).”
“should ever be eaten” renders an emphatic doubled verb, and NASB supplies “to his benefit”; “an offensive thing” renders “piggul,” refuse meat.
“his people” renders “its kinsmen” (also in verses 21, 25 and 27).
“must certainly not eat” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
